description: Architectural layers of the MossyMesh product (MessyMash blueprint), with honest build status.

layers.implementation: Identity-based routing (Ed25519 public keys, not IP/DNS). Kademlia DHT resolves keys. LoRa CSMA/CA and BLE on light links. No QUIC, no Reticulum dependency.
layers.name: Transport Layer

layers.implementation: Custom Merkle trie over Blake3 with YATA-inspired CRDT merge and LRU eviction. Active ledger <= 10 MB on edge. Recursive folding prover is a mock; nova-snark backend unwired.
layers.name: Ledger Consensus

layers.implementation: Core chess bitboard evaluation, deterministic WASM exports. Evaluation target ~836 Mnps class (target, not measured).
layers.name: Application Logic / Engine

layers.implementation: Symmetric static INT8 quantization for cross-device determinism. MEM_LIMIT = 10 MiB guest heap, enforced. Native WAMR behind a feature flag; pure-Rust host simulation runs tests today.
layers.name: Execution Sandbox

layers.implementation: Axum HTTP gateway, WebSocket sync with exponential backoff, TWAMM with 2% max-spread cap, HTLC escrows. VDF-delayed cancellation is a mock.
layers.name: Interop Gateway

layers.implementation: Voucher-based WoT onboarding with slash on malicious invitees; quadratic staking locks; 3-of-5 admin multi-sig decaying to zero over 90 days; ZK-blinded commit-reveal voting.
layers.name: Governance & Economy

layers.implementation: SITF compact tensor containers, vLLM-style page-table KV/context windows (RAM or file), named ops over SITF buffers. CPU backend is the real path; Vulkan backend exists.
layers.name: AI Processing

layers.implementation: Cross-crate smoke harness (SMK-01..SMK-08) running the real offline pipeline: interop accept, Wesolowski VDF admit, sandbox invoke, engine eval, consensus ledger insert, Merkle proof verify.
layers.name: Integration Harness

supporting.implementation: Offline-first TypeScript PWA served via captive portal. This site is part of it.
supporting.name: Frontend Layer

sybil_defense.primitive: Wesolowski VDF over RSA-2048 (replaced MinRoot in issue #199)
